description: Silencer quantity and location requirements for frames.
check_logic: Verify 3 silencers on strike side of single doors, 3 on center mullions, and 2 on the head of pairs without center mullions.

description: Removable stops require specific security fasteners.
match_criteria: Hollow Metal Frames with Removable Stops
check_logic: Ensure countersink style tamper-proof screws are specified.

description: Exterior double doors require specific astragal type.
check_logic: Validate that astragals are Steel, Z-shaped.
Verify astragal is specified for installation on the 'PUSH SIDE' of the Inactive Leaf.
Ensure threshold width equals Frame Depth + 1/2 inch.

description: Wind Borne Debris Impact requirements based on elevation.
check_logic: Openings < 30ft from grade must meet Large Missile Test. Openings > 30ft must meet Small Missile Test.
Verify louvers are UL or ITS listed fusible link type with the same rating as the door.
Ensure Power Supplies are excluded from the Hardware Set and noted as 'By Security Section' / 'By Others'.
Verify components are hot-dipped zinc-iron alloy-coated (galvannealed) A40/ZF120.

description: Frame gauge requirements based on opening width.
check_logic: Verify frames for openings over 4 ft wide are 16 gauge.
Verify frames are specified as Knock-down type (unless superseded by specific wind-load/impact assembly requirements).

description: Kick plate sizing relative to door width.
check_logic: Verify kick plate width is 2 inches less than nominal door width (e.g., 34 inch plate for 36 inch door).
